name: @psyb0t/mt5-httpapi
summary: Wire an OpenClaw agent to a self-hosted mt5-httpapi MetaTrader 5 bridge over MCP — the full REST surface (account, symbols, orders, positions, history, backtest) via a generic request tool.
description: A thin stdio<->HTTP bridge that connects an MCP client (OpenClaw, Claude, Cursor, Codex, ...) to a running mt5-httpapi terminal's MCP endpoint (/mcp), exposing its three tools: ping (lock-free liveness), endpoints (the full REST route catalog), and request (call any REST endpoint by method/path/query/body, in-process, through the exact same handler/auth/MT5 locking as a real HTTP call). mt5-httpapi is self-hosted — you run the server yourself and point this bridge at one terminal's base URL. Order and position mutations reached through request are real, irreversible actions on a live trading account. See https://github.com/psyb0t/mt5-httpapi.

MT5_API_URL.description: Base URL of your running mt5-httpapi (the bridge appends /mcp/). The server root, e.g. http://localhost:8888, bridges to every terminal with broker/account tool parameters; a terminal path, e.g. http://localhost:8888/<broker>/<account>, pins the bridge to one terminal.

MT5_API_TOKEN.description: Bearer token — required whenever the server's api_token is set (same token as the REST API); omit only if the server has auth disabled.
